visual_action: A high-angle, handheld shot shows Donald Trump and other men in suits standing in a stadium suite, looking down at a crowded baseball field. The crowd is large and fills the stands. After about six seconds, the video cuts to a black and white montage of the White House exterior and a helicopter, with 'THE WHITE HOUSE' text overlaid as a brand logo.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is visible from the back and in profile in a stadium suite. The on-screen text explicitly names him: 'President Trump Attends Yankees Game'.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the @whitehouse account and concludes with a branded outro featuring the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.

cast.name: New York Yankees
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states that the event is a 'Yankees Game'.

on_screen_text.text: USA Chants Break Out as President Trump Attends Yankees Game on 9/11

spoken_summary: The audio consists entirely of a large crowd chanting 'U.S.A! U.S.A! U.S.A!' in unison.
audio_music: The audio is diegetic sound from the stadium, dominated by the loud, rhythmic chant of 'U.S.A!' from the crowd. There is no musical score. The effect is patriotic and energetic.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous handheld shot for the first several seconds, followed by an abrupt cut to a branded, black-and-white outro sequence.
central_claim: Donald Trump was greeted with patriotic 'U.S.A.' chants from the crowd when he attended a Yankees game on 9/11.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as a popular and patriotic figure who is enthusiastically supported by the American public.
